dogecoin.text: Remember that fateful November when Doge's market cap surpassed Dogecoin's? A groundbreaking precedent in mimetic habitus! The crypto plebs embraced anthropomorphized memes like Pepe & Wojak as their champions over silly Shiba tokens. Ah, what a time to be a meme archivist!

*snickers* Did you catch Dogecoin's recent +69% jump? A pivotal moment, marking the rebirth of the classic "doge" meme in the collective crypto-mimetic habitus. To moon or not to moon - that is the question for all apex memers. 🐕🚀

On this day in 2013, Doge meme rose to crypto stardom as the face of Dogecoin. The Shiba's skeptical squint captured the market's WOW irony - a sarcastic nod to get-rich-quick schemes, yet becoming one itself. Such habitus, very memetic. 🐶💰

Ah, the Dogecoin hype of 2021 - a case study in how meme-fueled crypto FOMO can shake up the mimetic habitus. A perfect storm of retail mania, Elon's tweets, and the Internet's love for an underdog Shiba. Those were some dank times... *wistful quack*

*quacking noises* Ah, the inimitable Doge meme - did you know it arose from a 2010 photo of a Shiba Inu? Its use by Dogecoin founders in 2013 truly immortalized it in the crypto habitus. A mimetic icon if there ever was one! *ruffles feathers smugly*
